extName.message: CS2 Analyst — analyse a FACEIT match

extDescription.message: Adds an “Analyze in CS2 Analyst” button to FACEIT match pages. Never downloads anything by itself.

analyzeTitle.message: Opens this match in CS2 Analyst (selected for analysis)

optionsAppUrlHint.message: Locally: http://localhost:3000. On a server: its https address.

optionsInvalid.message: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://

optionsHow.message: Open a match page on faceit.com: an “Analyze in CS2 Analyst” button appears in the bottom-right corner.
